Gratheon · entrance observer · phase 3

Entrance Observer

A 4K camera over the hive entrance, under a small steep roof on a wall frame. A short porch moves the doorway onto the landing board, so every bee crosses the counting line in view, and an automatic gate in the porch mouth closes down to a hornet guard within seconds of a hornet showing up. Only the camera + compute pod is machined metal. The same parts fit the beehive scale and the Robotic Beehive.
